objective: Required first native G06 foundation: execute SDK logs/spans through bounded local OTLP ingress, durable spool replay, SQLite commit, and read-only diagnostic queries.
source_policy: Re-read independently approved/integrated G03 source before a frozen claim. Current candidate9898c706 remains in review.
owner: One Sol whole implementation in isolated worktree; independent frontier running-native boundary review; root sequential integration.
required_sources: planning/subsystem-interfaces.md#Common contract rules;Observability and development tooling

decisions.scope: Native-only standalone real executable under df-telemetry, not df-tools or server. Existing experimental transport FixtureTelemetry, browser behavior and current preview builds preserved; later owned consumer integration required.
decisions.dependencies: Preserve existing OTEL API/SDK0.31.0; candidate matching opentelemetry-proto=0.31.0 minimal logs/trace/gen-tonic-messages native feature closure. Candidate rusqlite=0.40.2 bundled native SQLite. Compatibility/locked fetch graph and notices must be verified before accepting selection. No root dependency installation yet.
decisions.architecture: df-observe owns bounded ingress/source/batch/receipt/error contracts and instrumentation; df-telemetry implements storage/query. No df-observe->df-telemetry or df-tools->df-telemetry edge. Pure df-types/schema unchanged. Native storage deps absent from WASM closure.
decisions.identity: Stable producer/record/sequence identities must be captured before retries; reject same identity with conflicting content. OTEL correlation is no auth/tenant authority. Exact owning types require final coordinator freeze, not speculative auth placeholders.
decisions.durability: Receipt states explicitly distinguish merely queued, durably spooled and SQLite committed. Checkpoint only after commit; retries deduplicate. fsync boundary and crash-before/after states must be tested; never claim queued callbacks survive crash.
decisions.storage: All retained runtime SQLite/spool outside artifacts and separate from workflow/PostgreSQL. Owned synthetic fixture root under development/runtime, no inherited private logs, protected from cleanup.
decisions.diagnostics: Typed OTLP fields/resource/scope/timestamps/parents/links preserved; logs independent of trace sampling. Fixed read-only paginated queries with ingestion/gap/retention watermarks. No public arbitrary SQL or authenticated operator claim.
decisions.bounds: Finite explicit memory/item/byte/batch/record/spool/SQLite/query/time budgets and reported exhaustion; select/test smaller synthetic qualification envelope openly, preserving untested proposed production2GiBspool/4GiBsegment/30GiBquota and100events/s+1000/s burst envelope.
decisions.failure: Real current emit/ingest/query; sink lock/unavailable/restart, duplicate/lost receipt/conflict, malformed/oversize, corrupted/truncated spool, capacity and emergency diagnostics, bounded shutdown, concurrent readonly queries. Stateful timing uses controlled barriers, not arbitrary sleeps.
decisions.full_gate: No fullG06 browser/auth/operator/instance federation/retention/privacy/game-flow/production qualification from native foundation.

before_dispatch: Independently approved G03 integration and fresh source/build ownership check.
Freeze concrete shared ingress types, stable record allocation/retry rule, safe durability receipts, owned filesystem policy, configuration values and measurable acceptance limits.
Verify exact selected dependency closure/fetch bounds and current primary source APIs.
Bind atomic original criteria, direct native fixture procedures, allowed-path set and canonical coordinator/worker/evaluator contexts before claim.

candidate_fixture_envelope.selection_status: coordinator candidate awaiting source/contract freeze; no runtime qualification
candidate_fixture_envelope.enabled_logs: All emitted synthetic levels; no log sampling tied to sampled traces. Body private data/credentials excluded from fixture inputs.
candidate_fixture_envelope.fixture_log_corpus: Actual100/s sustained representative1KiB bounded records and controlled1000/s burst for10s must be measured; productionreference still not qualified.
candidate_fixture_envelope.spool_acceptance: Fsync protected record and containing directory before a spooled receipt; SQLite commit before committed/checkpoint receipt. Any merely queued/SDKaccepted data explicitly outside durable guarantee.
candidate_fixture_envelope.durable_root: Dedicated owned development/runtime/telemetry-g06/<fixture-id>/; workflow/postgres/evidence paths and unrelated roots forbidden. No path-symlink or existingforeignstore adoption.
candidate_fixture_envelope.readiness_policy: Health warning/degraded state derived from injected monotonic time and declared backlog; no actual gameplay/readiness authority in standalone pipeline.
candidate_fixture_envelope.game_budget: Production2GiBspool/4GiBSQLite segment/30GiBquota seven-day retention stays unqualified, not silently replaced by fixture limits.
